entities.title: Wire identifier
entities.summary: The schema value every UTV value carries, utv/<MAJOR>.<MINOR> (utv/1.0); results carry utv-result/<MAJOR>.<MINOR>.
entities.notConfusedWith: The specification's full version 1.0.0: the patch number never appears on the wire.

entities.title: Kind
entities.summary: One of the 26 core value types named in a value's kind field: civil, instant, amount, interval, recurrence, uncertain and the rest.

entities.title: Civil value
entities.summary: A fielded calendar or time-of-day value under a named calendar, chronology and, optionally, zone; not totally ordered without context.

sources.symbol: §4 Civil dates, calendar fields and time of day

entities.notConfusedWith: An instant: a civil value need not name a single point on the timeline.

entities.title: Instant
entities.summary: A coordinate in a named timescale (POSIX, TAI, UTC, GPS, TT, …).
entities.notConfusedWith: A civil date-time with an offset, which is still a civil value with a fixed-offset zone.

entities.title: Zone intent (zoneIntent)
entities.summary: What controls a civil value's future re-resolution: follow-zone-id, follow-location-law, fixed-offset, fixed-instant, floating-wall or historical-assertion.
entities.notConfusedWith: The zone itself: the same zone can be followed by identifier or by the law of a location.

entities.title: Floating
entities.summary: A civil value with no zone selected (zone floating, or no zone at all), not attached to the timeline until an explicit operation does so.
entities.notConfusedWith: A value in UTC or in the host's zone.

entities.title: Resolution policy
entities.summary: How resolving a local time treats a DST gap (reject, preserve-unresolved, shift-forward-by-gap, …) and an overlap (reject, all, earliest, latest, offset-match, occurrence-index).
entities.notConfusedWith: The default: reject is recommended where one exact instant is required, and does not make the civil input invalid.

entities.title: Elapsed amount
entities.summary: A signed rational number of SI seconds in a stated physical-time context.

sources.symbol: §5 Exact elapsed time, calendar period and non-standard duration

entities.notConfusedWith: A calendar amount (P1D, P1M), whose length depends on the calendar, the zone and the day boundary; and POSIX seconds, which are not SI seconds across a leap second.

entities.title: Calendar amount
entities.summary: Typed calendar components (years, months, weeks, days, time part) applied by an operation with a policy.

sources.symbol: §5 Exact elapsed time, calendar period and non-standard duration

entities.notConfusedWith: An elapsed amount: one calendar day is not necessarily 86,400 SI seconds.

entities.title: none
entities.summary: A complete, valid query proven to have an empty result, such as a wall time in a DST gap or 31 January plus one month under the reject policy.
entities.notConfusedWith: invalid: none is a truthful answer to a meaningful question, not an error.

entities.title: multiple
entities.summary: More than one proven result, such as a wall time in a DST overlap; all candidates are returned.
entities.notConfusedWith: An error, or a reason to pick one silently.

entities.title: indeterminate
entities.summary: The semantics are defined but the evidence is insufficient or contested: even a capable engine cannot derive a unique answer.
entities.notConfusedWith: unsupported, which means this engine lacks the capability or the rules.

entities.title: unsupported
entities.summary: No installed registered algorithm or necessary immutable rules; also the answer for a newer wire version or an open issue the implementation hits.
entities.notConfusedWith: invalid (the input contradicts itself) and indeterminate (nobody could know).

entities.title: Manifest
entities.summary: The frozen rules, algorithm versions, reference datasets and evaluation context a result depended on.

sources.symbol: 16. Signature/reproducibility require immutable content, not a version name

entities.notConfusedWith: A version label: reproducibility needs immutable content, not a name.

entities.title: Conformance profile
entities.summary: A named subset an implementation may claim: core-civil, global-instant, zoned, recurrence, history, scientific, distributed, business or full.

entities.title: Fail closed
entities.summary: Reject unknown kinds, unknown core properties, unknown critical extensions, duplicate JSON keys and unknown specification versions rather than guessing.

entities.title: Loss report
entities.summary: What a conversion dropped or distorted, classified (lossless, information-losing, assumption-dependent, unrepresentable) with the affected fields.
entities.notConfusedWith: Adapter fidelity levels in STANDARDS-MATRIX.md, a separate vocabulary (OI-07).
